title: Black Tunic: A Vermouth Cocktail
ldInstructionsRaw: Combine all of the ingredients in a glass and fill with ice, then stir briefly to combine. (Alternately, gently heat the ingredients in a small pan and serve warm in a coffee mug.) While using a lit match or lighter, squeeze a lemon twist so the oils spray into the flame and across the drink’s surface, then use the twist as garnish.
